about: Figures are painted on a flat chroma-key screen (green unless an asset sets "screen") that art-ingest.py keys out. Ender's painted art set. Every entry is one image. scripts/art-generate.py renders them with a free open-weight model on this machine; images made elsewhere (for example Midjourney, using the same prompts) go in art/raw/<id>.png and scripts/art-ingest.py fits them to the game either way. Style evokes epic fantasy trading-card painting; no card game's frames, symbols, names or artists are referenced.

style.base: epic fantasy trading card illustration, traditional oil painting on canvas, painterly, dramatic chiaroscuro, strong rim light, rich saturated jewel tones, deep shadows, visible confident brushwork, highly detailed materials, masterful composition
style.figure: full body, single character, whole figure in frame with feet visible, floating in empty space, centered, isolated on a solid flat {screen} chroma key background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no base, no cast shadow
style.backdrop: vertical 9:16 environment painting, no people, no creatures, wide open empty ground across the lower half, deep atmospheric perspective, volumetric light shafts, cinematic depth
style.cardart: square full-bleed painting filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no frame, emblematic still life, one strong central subject, dark vignette, glowing focal light
style.texture: seamless tileable texture filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no frame, no border, flat even lighting, top-down, no perspective, no objects
